Privacy Policy

Effective Date: January 2025

Generator Switch Guide ("we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect information when you visit generatorswitchguide.com.

Information We Collect

Information You Provide

We may collect information you voluntarily provide, such as:

  • Email address (if you contact us or subscribe to updates)
  • Any information you include in messages to us

Automatically Collected Information

When you visit our site, we may automatically collect:

  • IP address and general location (country/region)
  • Browser type and device information
  • Pages visited and time spent on site
  • Referring website

We use this information to understand how visitors use our site and improve our content.

Cookies and Tracking

We may use cookies and similar technologies for:

  • Analytics: To understand site usage patterns
  • Affiliate tracking: Third-party retailers may use cookies to track referrals from our site
  • Advertising: If we display ads, ad networks may use cookies to serve relevant ads

You can control cookies through your browser settings. Note that disabling cookies may affect site functionality.

Third-Party Services

We use third-party services that may collect information:

  • Amazon Associates: When you click affiliate links, Amazon may collect information according to their privacy policy.
  • Analytics: We may use Google Analytics or similar services to analyze site traffic.
  • Advertising: If we display ads (e.g., Mediavine, Google AdSense), those networks have their own privacy practices.

We encourage you to review the privacy policies of these third parties.

How We Use Information

We use collected information to:

  • Provide and improve our content
  • Respond to your inquiries
  • Analyze site performance and user behavior
  • Comply with legal obligations

Information Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We may share information:

  • With service providers who help operate our site
  • When required by law or to protect our rights
  • In connection with a business transfer or merger

Data Security

We implement reasonable security measures to protect information. However, no internet transmission is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

Children's Privacy

Our site is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:

  • Access or delete your personal information
  • Opt out of certain data collection
  • Request information about our data practices

To exercise these rights, please contact us.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will post the updated version on this page with a new effective date.

Contact Us

Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact us at hello@generatorswitchguide.com.
